description: Which elections are scheduled in a Japanese prefecture between two dates? Name (Japanese and an English label we translate), type, local government code, notice date, voting day, term expiry and seats as published, with the official election commission page URL and a source receipt (URL, fetched_at, sha256, page update text). Prefectures not covered yet are listed with their official pages. Election-level facts only: no candidate data, no vote counts. Check the official page first.

from.description: Optional start date YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time (default today)

prefecture.description: Optional: prefecture name (Tokyo or 東京都), JIS code (13) or local government code (130001). Omit for all covered prefectures

to.description: Optional end date YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time (default from + 365 days; range at most 731 days)

type.description: Optional filter: governor, mayor, assembly, by-election, national or other

name: elections_upcoming

complete.description: true when every schedule page for the prefectures asked about was usable (read, parsed and fresh).

name_en.description: English label translated by this service (not an official name).

name_ja.description: Election name as published by the election commission (Japanese).

notice_date.description: Official notice date (kokuji/koji), YYYY-MM-DD, as published; null if not published.

seats.description: Number of seats to be filled, if published.

term_expiry.description: Term expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD, if published on the page.

vote_date.description: Voting day, YYYY-MM-DD, as published; null if not published yet.

official_check.description: Read first: check the official election commission page(s) listed here before relying on any date.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: found = elections in range on the pages checked; none_in_checked_pages = every page for the prefectures asked about was read and parsed within 72 hours and none lists an election in range (not a statement that no election will be held); not_covered = this prefecture is not read yet; unknown = a page is not loaded, gone or unreadable and nothing was found; stale = a page was last read more than 72 hours ago and nothing was found.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Upcoming elections in Japan by prefecture
